stages.name: Frames
stages.detail: 699 sharpest frames from 6,988 (3:53, 1280×1707)

stages.name: Camera poses
stages.detail: COLMAP global SfM with loop closure: 673 frames, 1.0 px; 12 outlier frames dropped

stages.name: Hands removed
stages.detail: Grounding DINO + SAM 2.1: hands in 366 frames (3.9 % of pixels) ignored in training

stages.name: Depth and scale
stages.detail: Depth Anything 3 per frame, 3.7 % median error vs SfM; camera height 1.1–1.8 m

stages.name: Gaussian splat (preview)
stages.detail: Half resolution, 320 k Gaussians, held-out PSNR 18.3 dB; moved items and opened doors still smear

stages.name: Object and front detection
stages.detail: 849 detections on 135 key frames lifted to 3D; metric world frame: DA3 scale and the counter-height prior agree within 5 %

stages.name: Joints from observed motion
stages.detail: 26 fronts measured by GPT-6 with the depth-plane tool; hinge/slide axes constrained to the panel edges; 15 parts have measured open states

stages.name: Articulated splat
stages.detail: 500 k Gaussians, 960×1280, per-frame joint states for 25 fronts (held-out PSNR 17.4; limited by the shared GPU budget)

stages.name: NeuralFeels from hand demonstrations
stages.detail: Tested on the demonstrated can: monocular depth is too noisy for a 6 cm object (held-out IoU 0.67) — small items use photo-fitted Blender models; kept for large objects

stages.name: Objects and cabinets (GPT-6, Blender)
stages.detail: 158 Blender assets from 11 GPT-6 set jobs (fridge, range, sink, cabinetry runs, cutlery, dishware, cookware, fridge/pantry/counter contents); mechanism + physics jobs running (latches, buttons, springs, friction)

stages.name: MuJoCo + Isaac Sim export
stages.detail: Native MuJoCo scene rests within 4 mm over 2 s; USD stage for Isaac Sim with 469 rigid bodies, 531 enabled physics joints, latch drives, welded stored contents and the 673 calibrated cameras — masses and limits match MuJoCo to 1e-6; validated with usd-core readback, not yet loaded in Isaac Sim

stages.name: Per-asset Gaussians + meshes
stages.detail: Each front and item gets its own Gaussians and a TSDF mesh from the splat (the measured twin of its Blender model)

stages.name: Realism QA (photo vs render)
stages.detail: GPT-6 re-renders every asset with the capture cameras, grades silhouette/proportions/colour/material/articulation and fixes it; cabinetry being rebuilt

stages.name: Mechanisms + physics
stages.detail: Fridge (gasket latch, bins, door drawers), microwave (two-stage release button), range/oven (21 N door breakaway, counterbalanced door, drawer, racks), faucet (swivel, pull-out head, lever), 14 cabinet doors + 4 drawers, kettle/espresso/rice cooker lid pop — all pass force tests

stages.name: Soft bodies
stages.detail: Sponge, scourer, oven towel, bread bag, sink cloth as MuJoCo flex; stable at 1 ms, settle and grasp tests pass; parameters from literature, drape shapes calibrated on the video

stages.name: Interactive scene + asset library + camera replay
stages.detail: Whole kitchen in MuJoCo WASM (240 objects, 123 joints with latches, stored contents released when their door opens); 160-asset library with force demos; 6-DoF camera replay with the real frames blended over the reconstruction

stages.name: Procedural kitchen generator
stages.detail: L/U/galley/island layouts; cabinets, drawers, appliances, hinge sides and forces parametrised with this kitchen as default; 20 seeds pass settle + joint checks; MJCF/USD/GLB export

stages.name: Construction fit and articulation audit
stages.detail: Cabinet runs and fridge rebuilt with real joinery; oven door re-squared (was 5° off); every joint swept for contacts. Photo overlays still 10–60 px on the long cabinet runs and appliances: monocular depth drifts locally by a few centimetres, the remaining gap to a LiDAR-grade capture

stages.name: World-frame refinement
stages.detail: Gravity from cabinet fronts, floor, walls and appliance edges: 2.8° tilt and 1.2° yaw removed from cameras, joints, layout and poses; vertical-edge mismatch to the photos dropped to 1–4° on every large asset

stages.name: Metric scale
stages.detail: Standard-size calibrators (30-inch range, wall plates, Nespresso height) give c = 0.943: scene shrunk 5.7 %, all 160 assets rebuilt at true size; a LiDAR capture would pin this to ~1 %

stages.name: Interaction and connection fixes
stages.detail: Viewer: every object selectable and movable in both looks (held objects release on grab), doors and drawers drag directly, stored contents ride with their doors and stay put until grabbed, kinematic joints stop at contacts (fridge sliders blocked by a closed door). Running: GPT-6 connection audit across all assets (faucet head on spout, towels on the oven handle, hinge clearances, support geometry) and a bundle rebuild with full Polished meshes.
